reads: the roster's text (or null when it cannot be read), the session id, whether the notepad exists, and whether the session root holds its marker

cases.name: prompt-working-row-no-file
cases.why: A working row with no notepad file is exactly the condition the rule exists to catch.

cases.name: prompt-working-row-with-file
cases.why: An existing file silences the rule whatever it holds: an empty notepad is a session that owes nothing.

cases.name: seat-row-with-no-file
cases.why: The seat keeps a notepad as a lane does, so its row with no file is told too.

cases.name: id-the-roster-does-not-name
cases.why: A session the roster does not name is not claimed, whatever its notepad holds.

cases.name: unreadable-roster
cases.why: The rule is silent whenever it cannot tell, and an unreadable roster is exactly that.

cases.name: root-absent
cases.why: A session root without its marker is the other named silent case, checked before the roster is even opened.

cases.name: empty-session-id
cases.why: An anonymous session cannot be matched against any row, so nothing is claimed.

cases.name: id-only-in-a-later-field
cases.why: The match is on the first field only; the id standing in another row's name field is not a row of its own.

cases.name: working-row-with-a-window
cases.why: window= is a trailing field on a lane's row, not a role, so it must not silence the rule.

cases.name: comment-and-blank-lines-are-skipped
cases.roster:
# The lanes this seat is conducting RIGHT NOW.
#
#   <session-uuid>  <name>  [seat]  [window=<tokens>]

aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa  09.20-x09
cases.why: The header's own comment lines and the blank line before the real row must not stop it from being found.

cases.name: id-mentioned-only-in-a-comment-line
cases.why: A commented-out mention of the id is not a row; only an uncommented first field claims a session, the other direction of the case above.
